The statistical threshold for atrophy images was set at P < .01 after correction for multiple comparisons with false discovery rate for both voxel-level and cluster-level analyses, and we accepted only clusters composed of 50 or more adjacent voxels.
The analysis threshold includes all voxels with gray matter.
